stem:
Sana dips turmeric paper into curd and into an ammonia cleaning solution. The turmeric paper stays yellow in the curd and turns red-brown in the ammonia solution.

What do these colour changes show?

teacher.key_rationale: Turmeric paper stays yellow in acidic media and turns red-brown in basic media, so curd is acidic and the ammonia solution is basic.
